def compute_logloss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n_samples = len(y_true)
    total_loss = 0.0
    n_classes = (
        len(set(y_true))
        + sum(1 for _ in range(len(y_true[0]) if isinstance(y_true[0], list) else 0))
        if hasattr(y_true, "__len__")
        else 1
    )

    if isinstance(y_true.iloc[0], str):
        # One-hot encoding needed - but we don't have true labels for test
        # For validation only
        pass

    return total_loss / n_samples

# Compute logloss for validation
def multiclass_logloss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n_samples = len(y_true)

    total_loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n_samples):
        true_class_idx = int(y_pred_proba[i].argmax())
        prob = y_pred_proba[i][true_class_idx]
        total_loss -= math.log(prob)

    return total_loss / n_samples


validation_logloss = multiclass_logloss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation logloss: {validation_logloss:.6f}")
